versions.content: The NM Coordinator shall set the NMcoordinatorSleepReady bit in the NM message via <BusNm>_SetSleepReadyBit to the value 1 at his actively coordinated channels, IF all nodes of the NM Coordination cluster are ready to sleep (RemoteSleepIndi- cation) AND IF NmSynchronizingNetwork is enabled a Nm_SynchronizationPoint () call has been received on the corresponding channel AND If all channels of this NM Coordination cluster are configured as NmActiveCo- ordinator == TRUE . AND If the NmBusType is not configured to NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM .
